# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolchild  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face. He has black eyes that stare with hostility, curiosity, or mockery.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, mischievous boy who displays an impertinent swagger and holds female teachers in contempt. He often acts with scornful disinterest or defiant mockery toward authority. Though stubborn and seemingly untouched by kind lectures, he can be brought to tears when faced with direct physical punishment.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

## Traits

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye is an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, and enrolled in the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. On his first day, he sat sullenly at a corner desk and later poured slate-bottle water down Aurelia Clay's neck, remaining completely untouched by Anne's lecture on being a gentleman. He openly voiced his dislike for Anne to other children, claiming female teachers were useless. In school, he habitually obeyed Anne with a scornful air of toleration and caused minor trouble, such as mocking her or planting a mouse in her desk drawer. After the mouse incident, Anne lost her temper and whipped him with a pointer, causing him to winced and cry, which left Anne feeling she had permanently lost any chance of winning his affection.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P34](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0034)_
